facts.fact: Civipol's MODERO project (EUR 8 million, January 2025 to December 2028) states it supports digitisation of registers, consolidation of the national civil status register (RNEC) and development of a civil status management solution in the Central African Republic.

CAF.note: Document does not mention a voters' roll.
No identity number at birth is stated.
Document does not mention land registration.
The RNEC is a civil status register; no population register is stated.

facts.fact: Civipol's MODERO project supports catch-up registration campaigns with a target of 40,000 registrations for internally displaced people in the Central African Republic.

CAF.note: Document says nothing on how or where local offices make the digital record, or on office counts.
Document does not mention a social registry.
Document does not mention a tax register.
